content.expected_result: Git retains exact prior definitions, state, reasons and attribution; Saga stores one current value.
preconditions: Use an isolated real Git repository with a feature, persona and proposed story S. Commit the original current definition.

steps.action: Edit current S through story revise, commit the changed content, and query Git-backed history for its stable URN.
steps.expected_result: History identifies the actual commits and authors; each committed tree contains its exact complete definition.

steps.action: Set S accepted with reason Agreed scope, commit it, and inspect the prior and current Git trees.
steps.expected_result: The previous state and new accepted state with its reason remain inspectable through Git; no lifecycle event graph is created.

content.title: Read earlier story content and state from real Git commits
